source: Ed4 C.6.5 to C.6.8, pp.C-71 to C-74; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2
description: A fixed-speed sender gets MAX-SEGMENT only, halved after a burst with more than half its D_PDUs in error.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2, 4, 6, 7 at Long (positions 0 to 3); thresholds measured on WN 2 Long bulk -100, 50, 150, 300 and latency -100, 100, 200, 400; on WN 4 Long bulk -100, 0, 100, 150 and latency -100, 100, 300, 400; on WN 6 Long bulk -100, 0, 300, 500 and latency -100, 200, 400, 600; on WN 7 Long bulk -100, -50, 100, 400 and latency -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8 bursts. Flow as drc-rx-capability-records-ed4: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, which records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long, block 256 bytes) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, so 21 headers whose EOWs are placed as interp C-1260 says: the top priority of Table C-25 first, then the rotation of the repeating set from its start. Earlier bursts (each burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) carry PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105) or a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (counted as a D_PDU error, C-0836). Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (interleaver 101, C-0462, C-0469), MAX-SEGMENT 0xA00 + value. At 100 to 160 a burst holds a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 with SENDER-APPROACH 0xB01, Fixed 1 (C-0479). At 200 to 260 a burst holds one type 7 from 0.0.1.3 to us whose data CRC fails: 1 header, 1 error, over half, so MAX-SEGMENT halves from 255 to 127 (interp C-1272). The CAPABILITY burst is clean (one clean burst, short of the clean run 2, so no doubling). Fixed speed (C-0950): no MAX-SPEED or LOW-SPEED, no top priority, rotation MAX-SEGMENT only: 0xA7F in all 21 headers.
